theorems.name: Solidity.Yul.Views.split_join
theorems.signature: theorem split_join (w b : Nat) : w % b + b * (w / b) = w

theorems.name: Solidity.Yul.Views.Field.save_unchanged
theorems.signature: theorem Field.save_unchanged (f : Field) (w : Nat) : f.save w ⟨f.find w, Nat.mod_lt _ (Nat.pow_pos (by decide))⟩ = w

theorems.name: Solidity.Yul.Views.Field.find_save
theorems.signature: theorem Field.find_save (f : Field) (w : Nat) (v : f.Value) : f.find (f.save w v) = v.val

theorems.name: Solidity.Yul.Views.Field.save_low
theorems.signature: theorem Field.save_low (f : Field) (w : Nat) (v : f.Value) : f.save w v % f.base = w % f.base

theorems.name: Solidity.Yul.Views.Field.save_high
theorems.signature: theorem Field.save_high (f : Field) (w : Nat) (v : f.Value) : f.save w v / f.base / f.modulus = w / f.base / f.modulus

theorems.name: Solidity.Yul.Views.Field.save_lt
theorems.signature: theorem Field.save_lt (f : Field) (w : Nat) (hw : w < 256 ^ 32) (v : f.Value) : f.save w v < 256 ^ 32

theorems.name: Solidity.Yul.Views.Field.find_saveWord
theorems.signature: theorem Field.find_saveWord (f : Field) (w : Roadmap.Word) (v : f.Value) : f.findWord (f.saveWord w v) = v

theorems.name: Solidity.Yul.Views.Field.saveWord_unchanged
theorems.signature: theorem Field.saveWord_unchanged (f : Field) (w : Roadmap.Word) : f.saveWord w (f.findWord w) = w

theorems.name: Solidity.Yul.Views.Field.find_save_above
theorems.signature: theorem Field.find_save_above (f g : Field) (w : Nat) (v : f.Value) (h : f.offset + f.width ≤ g.offset) : g.find (f.save w v) = g.find w

theorems.name: Solidity.Yul.Views.Field.find_save_below
theorems.signature: theorem Field.find_save_below (f g : Field) (w : Nat) (v : f.Value) (h : g.offset + g.width ≤ f.offset) : g.find (f.save w v) = g.find w

theorems.name: Solidity.Yul.Views.Field.find_save_disjoint
theorems.signature: theorem Field.find_save_disjoint (f g : Field) (w : Nat) (v : f.Value) (h : f.offset + f.width ≤ g.offset ∨ g.offset + g.width ≤ f.offset) : g.find (f.save w v) = g.find w
